arguments.summary: Investigated the cause of the failed-jobs backlog. The backlog was 1204 jobs with 47 malformed rows. The read replica was 12 minutes behind, so the primary was used for current counts. The failed jobs will be reviewed and processed to clear the backlog.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the failed jobs to identify the root cause and prevent future failures. Update the cron schedule to use UTC to avoid future drift issues.
